rule.statement: A cause of action must be disclosed in the plaint against the defendant, and the relief sought must be explained.
rule.supporting_quote: The plaintiffs have clearly explained in the plaint the basis upon which the 3rd defendant was brought in (i.e. the execution of deed No. 11848 by the 2nd defendant in favour of the 3rd defendant) and the relief sought against her.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 11 of the Civil Procedure Code
